name: royal-home-crm
description: CRM for a real-estate agency: React/Vite web client, Express API, Prisma/PostgreSQL, shared Zod schemas (npm-workspaces monorepo)

scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.map: node scripts/product-flows.mjs && node scripts/product-map.mjs && node scripts/product-map-simple.mjs
scripts.map:check: node scripts/product-flows.mjs --check && node scripts/product-map.mjs --check && node scripts/product-map-simple.mjs --check
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/ship.test.mjs scripts/cloud-test-report.test.mjs scripts/health-watch.test.mjs scripts/backup-deal-docs.test.mjs scripts/pre-push.test.mjs scripts/audit-vi-mock.test.mjs scripts/audit-secrets.test.mjs scripts/auto-deploy.test.mjs scripts/ops-scripts.test.mjs scripts/script-env-order.test.mjs scripts/agent-stand-template.test.mjs scripts/sync-main.test.mjs scripts/bot-turn-trace-compose.test.mjs .github/scripts/sync-guard.test.mjs
scripts.audit:cycles: madge --extensions ts,tsx --circular apps/api/src && madge --extensions ts,tsx --circular apps/web/src
